line.en: Located in Ras Al Khor, Dubai, this car showroom was designed to maximize spatial efficiency while creating a chic, contemporary interior.

brief.en: The design focuses on enhancing openness through an extended and reconfigured ceiling design, to create a greater sense of height, space, and airiness. Every design decision balances functionality with refined aesthetics, resulting in a showroom that feels expansive, inviting, and thoughtfully designed to showcase the vehicles.
